_doc: The console's secret skins, one row per Zig `Skin` tag (cli/src/app/skin.zig `Traits`), shared by the CLI's TUI and the browser's and desktop's CLI mode. A row's `word` is the slash command that puts it on (typed again: off); `phrase`/`phraseOff` are said in gold as it goes on/off; `wordmark` replaces `S T E N C I L` beside the logo (`wordmarkAccented`: set in the accent); `mark` draws a P or M in place of the S. Traits: `animated` (moves on its own at `frameMs`), `movesLogo` (the animation moves the logo art), `paintsRuns` (each accent cell in its column's hue, `hues.hueStep` degrees apart; `slides` moves the hues one column a frame), `paintsCells` (every cell's fg + bg are `fg`/`bg`, the title bar `titleFg`/`titleBg`), `replacesLetters` (each accent letter becomes a picture from `pictures`, swapped every `pictures.swapFrames`), `wash` (the selection tint; absent = the theme accent). `gold` is the one colour no skin rewrites. The CLI embeds this file and derives its SGR/OSC bytes; cli/tests/config/skins_drift_test.zig pins its table to it.
